2026_04_KC_LV.headline: Kansas City’s passing rhythm collides with an undefeated Raiders defense built on disruption
2026_04_KC_LV.paragraph1: Patrick Mahomes leads Kansas City into Las Vegas against a Raiders defense built around Maxx Crosby’s edge pressure and a secondary that has helped fuel a 3-0 start. Andy Reid’s offense needs to keep Mahomes out of long-yardage situations, while Brock Bowers gives the Raiders a matchup piece capable of sustaining drives and limiting Kansas City’s possession advantage. Protection, third-down execution and whether Crosby can consistently collapse the pocket should shape the rivalry game.
2026_04_KC_LV.model_rationale: Las Vegas can create volatility with pressure and takeaways, but Kansas City’s ability to protect Mahomes and avoid negative plays is the clearest counter to that defensive strength.
